title: Lena and the Hymn
author: Ansel Ishikawa
blurb: Oscar Crane, a twin who came home to bury the wrong sibling, keeps the lights on and the doors counted. Then the village's church bell rings although the bell was melted down in 1911 — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must return what was taken in 1974, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
